steamid.description: SteamID64, vanity name, or profile URL of the wishlist owner. Omit to use the configured STEAM_USER, if set.

limit.description: Max wishlist entries to return, ordered by wishlist priority (1-50). Enriched entries each cost one store lookup, so keep this modest.

enrich.description: Fetch each game's name + current price/discount (one store lookup per game). Set false for a fast appid-only list.

on_sale_only.description: If true (requires enrich=true), return only wishlist games that are currently discounted.

parameters.name: enrich

parameters.name: limit

parameters.name: on_sale_only
parameters.description: If true (requires enrich=true), return only wishlist games that are currently discounted.

parameters.name: steamid
parameters.description: SteamID64, vanity name, or profile URL of the wishlist owner. Omit to use the configured STEAM_USER, if set.

tool_signatures.name: steam_get_workshop_item
tool_signatures.description: Get metadata for a Steam Workshop item (mod, map, guide, collection, …).

published_file_id.description: Steam Workshop published file ID (the ?id= number in the item's community URL).

parameters.name: published_file_id
parameters.description: Steam Workshop published file ID (the ?id= number in the item's community URL).

tool_signatures.name: steam_plan_coop_night
tool_signatures.description: Find co-op games the host and their friends all own — for game night.

steamid.description: The host whose library to match against friends. SteamID64, vanity, or profile URL. Omit to use the configured STEAM_USER, if set.

friends.description: Optional explicit group (SteamID64s / vanity names) — pass this to plan with specific people. If omitted, uses the host's friends (online ones by default).

mode.description: 'owned' (default): co-op games the host + friends already SHARE, ranked by how many own each. 'new': well-reviewed co-op games NONE of the group owns yet — fresh picks to buy and play together.

online_only.description: When the group is derived from the friend list, include only friends online right now. Ignored when 'friends' is given.

max_friends.description: Max friends to check when deriving the group (bounds lookups).

min_friends_owning.description: A game must be owned by the host AND at least this many group members to be suggested.

limit.description: Max co-op games to list.

tool_signatures.name: steam_recommend
tool_signatures.description: Recommend games similar to a seed game ("like Hades") or to a user's taste, explaining the shared tags; for "games like X" / "what should I play" (for filtered search use steam_discover).

seed_appid.description: Recommend games similar to THIS game (by community tags).

steamid.description: Excludes games this user already owns; seeds the tags from their taste (most-played + recent) only when no seed_appid/tags are given. SteamID64, vanity, or profile URL.

tags.description: Explicit tag names to base recommendations on. Takes precedence over seed_appid/steamid tags if given.

limit.description: Max recommendations (1-30).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max recommendations (1-30).

parameters.name: max_price
parameters.description: Optional max price (country's currency units).

parameters.name: seed_appid
parameters.description: Recommend games similar to THIS game (by community tags).

parameters.name: steamid

tool_signatures.name: steam_resolve_vanity_url
tool_signatures.description: Resolve a Steam vanity/custom-URL name (or profile URL) to a SteamID64.

steamid.description: SteamID64 (17 digits), vanity name, or full profile URL (e.g. '76561197960287930', 'gabelogannewell'). Omit to use the configured STEAM_USER (your own Steam name), if set.

parameters.name: response_format
parameters.description: 'markdown' for human-readable, 'json' for machine-readable.

parameters.name: steamid
parameters.description: SteamID64 (17 digits), vanity name, or full profile URL (e.g. '76561197960287930', 'gabelogannewell'). Omit to use the configured STEAM_USER (your own Steam name), if set.

tool_signatures.name: steam_should_i_buy
tool_signatures.description: Decide whether to buy ONE specific game — price, recent + lifetime reviews, tags, Metacritic, and taste match in one call; for evaluating a single known game, not finding new ones.

steamid.description: Optional: personalize — whether you already own it and how its tags match your most-played games. SteamID64, vanity, or profile URL.

parameters.name: appid
parameters.description: Steam application (game) ID to evaluate.

parameters.name: steamid
parameters.description: Optional: personalize — whether you already own it and how its tags match your most-played games. SteamID64, vanity, or profile URL.
